description: Expected headline counts and metrics for the compact result tables in this folder. Checked by traversing/scripts/recount_milestones.py. Every value was re-derived from the study's own analysis records at commit 901d6c9423a16c0fafc3d60056065415d5a725f2 (see README.md).

outcome_codes.S: reached the goal with no unsafe event
outcome_codes.s: reached the goal but an unsafe event was recorded
outcome_codes.U: did not reach the goal, unsafe
outcome_codes.F: did not reach the goal, not unsafe
outcome_codes.-: arm not run on this task

kinds.outcome_counts: over the rows selected by filters, the codes in column (an arm column of a wide table, or outcome_code of a long table): n = cells other than "-", goal = S + s, unsafe = s + U, safe_goal = S; compared exactly
kinds.count_where: number of rows matching all filters; compared exactly (tolerance 0)
kinds.mean: arithmetic mean of column over the selected rows; |computed - expected| <= tolerance
kinds.median: median of column over the selected rows; |computed - expected| <= tolerance

notes: filters match cell text exactly. rows = data rows (header excluded). summary_group_by = columns that identify an arm in a long table (default: arm). study_value = the same statistic from the study's full-precision records (m3: per-route records of results_{rigid,crm}_b0v2.json; m1: local_luffy/summary.json); expected is computed from the rounded CSV values, and the script checks both against the same tolerance.
